slides.headline: THESE 6 FREE AI PROMPTS REPLACE THE $1,000 COURSE YOU WERE ABOUT TO BUY
1) TURN YOUR EXPERTISE INTO A FINISHED EBOOK
slides.body: Your knowledge is a ready-to-sell ebook waiting to happen. 'Here is a transcript of me explaining [topic]. Turn it into a 10-chapter ebook outline and write chapter one in my voice'

slides.headline: 2) PACKAGE YOUR EXPERIENCE INTO AN ONLINE COURSE
slides.body: What you know is worth $497 to $2,000 per student. 'I'm an expert in [X]. Build a 6-module course: titles, lesson plans, one exercise per module, and a sales page headline'

slides.headline: 3) TURN YOUR ADVICE INTO A CLIENT MAGNET
slides.body: Your advice as a free guide pulls in clients at $0 ad spend. 'My business does [X]. Write a 5-page guide solving my customer's biggest problem. End with a reason to hire me'

slides.headline: 4) TURN YOUR BEST ADVICE INTO EMAILS THAT SELL
slides.body: Your expertise, dripped out as emails, earns $36 for every $1 spent. 'Write a 5-email welcome sequence for [my business]. Each email teaches one lesson and naturally leads to booking a call'

slides.headline: 5) SELL YOUR KNOWLEDGE AS A LIVE WORKSHOP
slides.body: What you know fills a $500 to $5,000 afternoon workshop. 'Create a 90-minute workshop on [topic] for [audience]. Include talking points, exercises, and a slide outline. End with a pitch for my service'

slides.headline: 6) BUILD A FREE TOOL THAT SELLS YOUR SERVICE
slides.body: Your industry knowledge, built into a free tool, replaces $50 a month software. 'Build a [industry] calculator as a web page. User enters [inputs], gets [output], sees my name and a booking link'

slides.headline: SAVE THIS POST
slides.body: You'll want these prompts the day you sit down to build. We share daily AI news and real skills you can use tonight
